an7.66:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati ambapālivane.
an7.66:2.4: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccituṃ.
an7.66:3.1: sineru bhikkhave, pabbatarājā caturāsīti yojanasahassāni āyāmena, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni vitthārena, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamudde ajjhogāḷho, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamuddā accuggato.
an7.66:3.2: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni devo na vassati.
an7.66:3.3: deve kho pana bhikkhave, avassante ye kecime bījagāmabhūtagāmā osadhitiṇavanaspatayo te ussussanti visussanti visussanti na bhavanti.
an7.66:3.5: evaṃ addhuvā bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave, saṅkhārā. yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabba saṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ,
an7.66:4.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena dutiyo suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:4.2: dutiyassa bhikkhave, suriyassa pātubhāvā yā tā kunnadiyo kussubbhā tā ussussanti, visussanti, na bhavanti.
an7.66:4.3: evaṃ aniccā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ addhuvā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave saṅkhārā. yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabba saṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ.
an7.66:5.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tatiyo suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:5.2: tatiyassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.66:5.3: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā ussussanti visussanti na bhavanti.
an7.66:5.4: evaṃ aniccā bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, evaṃ addhuvā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave, saṅkhārā. yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ,
an7.66:6.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena catuttho suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:6.2: catutthassa bhikkhave, suriyassa pātubhāvā ye te mahāsarā yato imā mahānadiyo sambhavantī, seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.66:6.3: anotattaṃ, sīhapapātaṃ, rathakāraṃ, kaṇṇamuṇḍaṃ, kuṇālaṃ, chaddantaṃ mandākinī. tā ussussanti visussanti. na bhavanti.
an7.66:7.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena pañcamo suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:7.2: pañcamassa bhikkhave, suriyassa pātubhāvā yojanasatikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti, dviyojanasatikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti, tiyojanasatikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti, …pe… sattayojana satikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti,
an7.66:7.3: sattatālampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chatālampi pañcatālampi catutālampi titālampi dvitālampi tālamattampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti,
an7.66:7.4: sattaporisampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chaporisampi …pe… pañcaporisampi …pe… catuporisampi …pe… tiporisampi …pe… dviporisampi …pe… porisampi …pe… aḍḍhaporisamattampi …pe… kaṭimattampi …pe… jaṇṇukāmattampi …pe… gopphakamattampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.
an7.66:7.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante tattha tattha gopadesu udakāni ṭhitāni honti,
an7.66:7.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, tattha tattha gopadamattāni mahāsamudde udakāni ṭhitāni hontī.
an7.66:7.7: pañcamassa bhikkhave, suriyassa pātubhāvā aṅgulapabbatemanamattampi mahā samudde udakaṃ na hoti.
an7.66:7.8: evaṃ aniccā bhikkhave saṃkhārā, evaṃ addhuvā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ,
an7.66:8.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena chaṭṭho suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:8.2: chaṭṭhassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavī sineru ca pabbatarājā dhūpāyanti sandhūpāyanti sampadhūpāyanti.
an7.66:8.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kumbhakārapāko ālimpito paṭhamaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhūpeti sandhūpeti sampadhūpeti.
an7.66:8.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, chaṭṭhassa suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavi sineru ca pabbatarājā dhūpāyanti sandhūpāyanti sampadhūpāyanti.
an7.66:8.5: evaṃ aniccā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ addhuvā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave saṅkhārā, yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ,
an7.66:9.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena sattamo suriyo pātubhavati.
an7.66:9.2: sattamassa bhikkhave, suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavi sineru ca pabbatarājā ādippanti, pajjalanti, ekajālā bhavanti.
an7.66:9.3: imissā ca bhikkhave, mahāpaṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ ḍayhamānānaṃ aggī vātena khittā yāva brahmalokāpi gacchanti.
an7.66:9.4: sinerussa ca bhikkhave, pabbatarājassa jhāyamānassa ḍayhamānassa vinassamānassa mahatā tejokhandhena abhibhūtassa yojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti, dviyojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti, tiyojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti, catuyojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti, pañcayojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti.
an7.66:9.5: imissā ca bhikkhave, mahāpaṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ ḍayhamānānaṃ neva chārikā paññāyati na masi
an7.66:9.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sappissa vā telassa vā jhāyamānassa ḍayhamānassa neva chārikā paññāyati na masi,
an7.66:9.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, imissā ca mahā paṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ ḍayhamānānaṃ neva chārikā paññāyati na masi.
an7.66:9.11: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccituṃ.
an7.66:10.1: tatra bhikkhave, ko mantā, ko saddhātā
an7.66:10.2: ayañca mahāpaṭhavi sineru ca pabbatarājā ḍayhissanti, vinassissanti, na bhavissantīti aññatra diṭṭhapadehi.
an7.66:11.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an7.66:11.2: sunettassa kho pana bhikkhave, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an7.66:11.3: sunetto bhikkhave satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an7.66:11.4: ye kho pana bhikkhave, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ brahmalokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an7.66:11.5: ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā appekacce paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu. appekacce gahapatimahāsālānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an7.66:12.1: atha kho bhikkhave sunettassa satthuno etadahosi.
an7.66:12.2: na kho panetaṃ patirūpaṃ yohaṃ sāvakānaṃ samasamagatiyo assaṃ abhisamparāyaṃ yannūnāhaṃ uttariṃ mettaṃ bhāveyyanti.
an7.66:13.1: atha kho bhikkhave, sunetto satthā sattavassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesi.
an7.66:13.2: sattavassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā sattasaṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe nayimaṃ lokaṃ punarāgamāsi.
an7.66:13.3: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudaṃ bhikkhave, loke ābhassarūpago hoti,
an7.66:13.5: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave, brahmā hoti mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu daso vasavattī.
an7.66:13.6: chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho pana bhikkhave, sakko ahosi devānamindo.
an7.66:13.7: anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosi cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
an7.66:13.8: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā ahesuṃ surā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
an7.66:13.9: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasi.
an7.66:13.10: so hi nāma bhikkhave, sunetto satthā evaṃ dīghāyuko samāno evaṃ ciraṭṭhitiko aparimutto ahosi
an7.66:13.11: jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. aparimutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.66:14.4: ariyassa sīlassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā, ariyassa samādhissa, ariyāya paññāya, ariyāya vimuttiyā ananubodhā appaṭivedhā.
an7.66:14.5: tayidaṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ sīlaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, ariyo samādhi anubuddho paṭividdho, ariyā paññā anubuddhā paṭividdhā, ariyā vimuttī anubuddhā paṭividdhā, ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
an7.66:14.7: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
